description: List your contacts, newest first; page with nextBefore. search and campaignId narrow the list, and totalCount counts every match, so finding a contact or counting them takes one call. limit 1 is enough for a count. To check several businesses, domains or emails, e.g. which of them a campaign already has, send them all as one search list: searchCounts says per term how many contacts match.

before.description: The nextBefore of the previous page

campaignId.description: Only the recipients of this campaign

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

limit.description: Maximum saved contacts to return on this page. At most 500.

search.description: One or more business names, domains or emails, e.g. ["castledental.com", "Gulf Coast Plumbing"]; send every term you want to check in this one list

searches.description: Old name of a search list; send the terms in search. At most 100 items.

name: contacts_list

searchCounts.description: Per term of a search list, how many contacts match it within campaignId; 0 means none

totalCount.description: All contacts matching search and campaignId, across every page

title: List your contacts, newest first; page with nextBefore
